note: World-look builder assets (wave 2). All CC0. Fetched + packed by tools/assets/fetch-world.mjs. Every entry lists url, licence, author and the target path it ends up in. Terrain layers come from ambientCG; the vegetation cut-outs (needle sprigs, leaves, grass blades, ferns) are cropped out of Poly Haven's CC0 tree/plant texture sets — the Poly Haven MESHES are not used (fir_tree_01 alone is 7.0 M triangles / a 478 MB .bin, three orders of magnitude over the whole vegetation budget), only their photographic alpha cut-outs, which are what a card-based tree actually needs.

polyhaven.author: Poly Haven (Rob Tuytel, Rico Cilliers et al.)
polyhaven.url: resolved per asset from https://api.polyhaven.com/files/{asset} (the map key and the file stem disagree per set)

terrainLayers.note: needle/leaf litter with sticks and pebbles. Deliberately the neutral brown-grey set, not the warm Ground082L: the shader tints the forest floor toward the canopy colour, and starting from an orange litter made a spruce wood read as a ploughed field between the trunks.

foliageAtlasCells.note: 4x3 grid of 256px cells in foliage-atlas.png (1024x768 RGBA); row 0 = conifer sprigs, row 1 = broadleaf clusters + bare twigs, row 2 = trunk bark tiles (pre-repeated 1x3 so one cell covers a whole trunk).

decimation.method: vertex clustering on a uniform grid over the mesh bounding box, cell representative = mean of its vertices; degenerate triangles dropped; normals recomputed area-weighted
